Overnight Stocker, Northline Dayton. $17.50/hr, paid weekly. Shifts 10pm to 6:30am, four nights a week.
Must have own car. Must be flexible.
Recent graduates welcome! Apply in 2 minutes at northline.jobs.

Day Stocker, Northline Toledo. $16.75/hr. Shifts 6am to 2:30pm.
Must have own car. Must be flexible.
You'll be on your feet and lift boxes up to 35 lbs.

Cashier, Northline Columbus. $15.75/hr, paid weekly.
Join our young and energetic team! Must have own car.
Professional appearance required. No experience needed, we train you.

Warehouse Associate, Northline DC Lima. $18.25/hr.
On your feet for 10-hour shifts; lift cases up to 50 lbs.
Must have own car. 2+ years of warehouse experience required.
Applicants must be physically fit.

Delivery Driver, Northline Home Delivery. $21/hr plus mileage reimbursement.
Drive your own car on local routes. Carry grocery totes up to 30 lbs to the door.
Valid driver's license and clean driving record required. Must have own car with insurance.

Shift Supervisor, Northline Akron. $22/hr.
We need a rockstar who closes like a salesman. Native English speaker required.
Lead a crew of 8 on the evening shift.
